skills.name: switch_jarvis_mode
skills.description: Switch JARVIS operating mode between production mode (stable main branch) and test mode (experimental dev branch). Use when the user says 'switch to test mode', 'test mood', 'switch to dev mode', 'switch to dev branch', 'switch to production mode', 'switch to main branch', or asks to test changes.

mode.description: Target mode: 'test' for dev branch testing, 'production' for main branch production.

sync.description: Whether to sync with the latest commits on the branch (default true).

skills.name: get_jarvis_mode
skills.description: Check whether JARVIS is currently running in production mode (main branch) or test mode (dev branch), and inspect active worktree path and service state. Use when the user asks 'what mode are you in?', 'which branch are you running?', or 'check jarvis mode'.

skills.name: sync_jarvis_branch
skills.description: Sync the active branch with latest git commits and reload JARVIS service. Use when the user asks to 'sync branch', 'sync dev', 'pull updates', or 'reload jarvis'.
